modules.module_title: Design plan for event, meeting or conference

pcs.pc_description: identify client preference for the type of events like theme-based events or traditional, etc.
prepare the scope of the event, meeting or conference including time, date, location, and budget
obtain information on the attendee profile to choose the type of meal and snacks etc.
scout and inspect venues to suit the client preference
identify the operational and resource requirements
liaise with vendors to get bids and determine best fits for the budget and goals
provide accurate details about the capacity and availability of the venue
suggest on the appropriateness of the venue for the type of event, meeting or conference to be held
analyze possible layout options that are achievable within venue constraints
suggest alternative arrangements in case of unavailability on the required date or layout of the facility
provide accurate information related to access restriction of the facilities
outline the benefits and advantages of the venue
suggest suitable additional services that can be offered for venue hiring
calculate accurate cost information for the venue and services
calculate and compare costs of services from different vendors to maximize cost- effectiveness
negotiate with the service providers or vendors to optimize delivery and cost-saving
prepare the budget including service charges, mark-ups, and miscellaneous expenses
present the plan and budget proposal to the client
handle client queries, if any
negotiate on the services, terms, and conditions
provide the customer with full schedules and costs, and update them of any changes throughout
communicate the necessary legal and other information clearly to the client
get client approval for processing of the contract

modules.module_title: Organize the event, meeting or conference

pcs.pc_description: gather all the necessary information about the event, meeting or conference and customer requirements, as agreed
establish procedures to ensure that requirements are met and contingencies are developed
keep accurate records of agreements made and requirements of suppliers both within and outside the organization
allocate staff responsibilities and brief them on duties, relevant procedures and any information they need to deliver the event
make sure that the equipment and materials needed for the event are on site well in time
inspect the venue to make sure that it has been prepared in line with requirements and to the standard agreed
coordinate logistics and services, including technology and equipment needed to run the event, food, drinks, transportation, etc.
organize sponsorships and advertisements, and marketing collaterals, if required
set the décor and seating arrangement as per client requirement
ensure to make special arrangements for VIPs, or invitees with special needs, if required
arrange for the signages, badges, registration materials, presentation support, plaque cards, attendee tracking, etc., as required
arrange for recreational or entertainment programs and shows as per client requirement
organize media coverage, if required
arrange for food, snacks and catering services at different time slots during the event, meeting or conference
arrange for security and first aid kits at the event
arrange for traffic control, car parking facility or valet parking, if required in and around the venue
inform participants and vendors of any cancellations or postponement of the event conference or meeting

modules.module_title: Supervise the event, conference or meeting

pcs.pc_description: coordinate different departments contributing to the running of the event
ensure food preparation and service is undertaken in a way that accounts for any specified requirements (e.g. vegetarian food, allergy problems)
liaise with the client throughout the event, conference or meeting to make sure that the arrangements meet their requirements
monitor the event, conference or meeting to make sure it is running as per plan and deal with any problems that may disrupt operations
make sure the event, conference or meeting and all associated activities comply with relevant legislation and organizational standards
monitor the progress of the event, conference or meeting and timeline of the programs on location
ensure hygiene standards are maintained in catering services
accommodate any last-minute request/alteration from the client
handle client complaints, if any
ensure cleanliness of the venue is maintained throughout the program
ensure all timelines are followed and the venue is vacated before the deadline
check that all decorations and audio-visual, lighting arrangements, etc. are dismantled properly at the end of the event
ensure all debris, spills, leftover food, etc. are cleared and the venue is cleaned
record information on the event to help in future event planning
provide feedback to staff to improve their performance, where appropriate
prepare a summary report on the arranged event, conference or meeting for management records
report the findings to the senior management of the organization
share a feedback form with the client on the services rendered
make note of unavoidable problems and those that were caused due to system or individual faults
record the evaluation of the event in a manner appropriate to the client feedback
